author: Inside Edition
description: A prominent judge is being accused of stalking. The alleged victim has been identified as a lawyer who was dating the judge's ex-boyfriend. Lawyer Kelci Binau obtained a temporary protection order against Judge Bridget Robb. The judge allegedly stalked the attorney at her home, her boyfriend's home, restaurants and a pilates studio where she works out. Robb has not been criminally charged but after an uproar she announced she is retiring, effective in two weeks.
title: Prominent Judge Accused Of Stalking Lawyer

author: Inside Edition
description: Gregory Bovino is the commander of ICE operations in Minneapolis. While most agents keep their faces hidden from view. Bovino makes his presence known with his face exposed. His long, double-breasted trenchcoat with wide lapels is hitting a nerve. California Governor Gavin Newsom says the coat looks like an "SS garb." Bovino explained the history of his "Greatcoat," worn by commanders on both sides during the world wars.
title: ICE Commander Gregory Bovino Speaks Out About His Greatcoat

author: Inside Edition
description: Many homeowners across the country are doing what is being called "house burping," where they open windows and doors for a few minutes each day, even in sub-zero temperatures. Lauren Cavalieri spoke with Inside Edition's Steven Fabian, who says she's been house burping for years. "I try to do this at least every other day," Cavalieri says. "It seems odd but you have to let that stale energy, that air out to let the fresh air in so it recirculates."
title: What Is House Burping?

title: What To Look Forward To At UFC 324 #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: As America braces for Winter Storm Fern, the leaders of the states and cities in its path are sounding dire warnings. As many families hunker down, home improvement expert Brian Kelsey gave Inside Edition some tips about how to prevent a disaster. Autocare expert Richard Rubino says motorists who venture out should carry spare windshield wiper blades, a battery booster device, and a portable tire inflator.
title: Tips To Help Prevent Disaster During Winter Storm

author: Inside Edition
description: Thirteen kids were rescued from their parents in 2018. 17-year-old Jordan Turpin escaped and called 911. The kids were rescued after years of abuse at the hands of their parents. Some had been starved and chained to the furniture. Both parents pled guilty to charges of child abuse and torture, They were sentenced to 24 years to life in prison in California. Three of the Turpin kids are telling their story to Diane Sawyer in "The Turpins: A New House of Horror."
title: 3 Turpin Kids Speak Out After Years Of Being Abused By Parents

author: Inside Edition
description: Barron Trump is being hailed a hero for calling the police as his female friend was allegedly beaten and raped 3,000 miles away in London. It happened last January, two days before President Donald Trump's inauguration. At the time, Barron was with his family heading to Washington. The friend's boyfriend, a 22-year-old MMA fighter, was arrested is facing assault and rape charges. The accused is on trial in London and denies the charges.
title: Man Charged With Rape After Barron Trump Makes Emergency Call To UK

author: Inside Edition
description: The Octagon Girls will bring that something special to UFC 324 kicking off Saturday night in Las Vegas, and it is debuting on Paramount Plus. UFC is entering a new era of mixed martial arts. Inside Edition's Stacy Gualandi went behind-the-scenes before the big fight to talk to some of the Octagon Girls. Red De La Cruz and Chrissy Blair say their role in the Octagon is not just eye-candy. They also shared their beauty routine for the big event.
title: Behind-The-Scenes Of UFC 324 With The Octagon Girls

author: Inside Edition
description: A table surfing challenge is sweeping the internet. An overturned folding table is tied to a car, then thrill seekers hold on as they are whipped from side to side. A teenage boy lost his life trying the stunt. David Nagy,17, was propelled into the grill of a parked car. His parents say they were stunned that he would even try such a dangerous stunt and say social media is partly to blame. The parents spoke with Inside Edition so other youngsters and their parents knew the dangers of the stunt.
title: Parents Of Teen Who Died During 'Table Surfing Challenge' Speak Out

author: Inside Edition
description: A desperate mother hands off her child to firefighters responding to a building blaze with multiple people trapped inside. The child's arm reached for her mother as she was carried all the way down the ladder. Officials in Wyoming, Minnesota, say firefighters braved single-digit temperatures to make the rescue. The fire spread to the roof and collapsed part of the building, making it difficult for firefighters to get inside. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Child Cries For Mother As Firefighter Carries Her Away From Burning Apartment
